what: Work done on another phone after the reset (but synced later) is thrown away: the higher epoch wins outright, so anything newer than the reset is lost, including newly logged real gases.
evidence: S3: A offline adds done 'l-after', xp+7 and logs a gas; B resets and syncs; A comes online -> A adopts [epoch 1, xp 0, done [], log 0]. Only localStorage 'buffer_before_drive' keeps it, with no UI.
fix: Store resetAt (ISO) with the epoch. When adopting a higher epoch, re-merge local items whose timestamps are after resetAt (gaslog/cmist by u, days >= reset date, sess with d >= reset date, qmiss values > resetAt). At minimum show a toast 'Progress was reset on another device. Undo on this phone' that restores buffer_before_drive.

what: Two phones connecting at the same moment create two 'My Apps/hub/buffer' folders; each phone caches its own folder id in buffer_drive_ids and keeps using it, so the phones never merge again and Citrus sees two status.json files. Same risk when Citrus and Buffer create 'My Apps' or 'hub' at once.
evidence: t25/race.py: both phones tap Connect together -> state.json in two different buffer folders (f5, f7); A ids f3/buffer=f7, B f3/buffer=f5; after 2 more sync rounds A done ['l-a'], B done ['l-b'] (never merged).
fix: In folder(), always list by name+parent (orderBy createdTime) and use the oldest; if more than one exists, merge the newer folder's state.json into the oldest and trash the extra folder. Re-validate the cached id against the oldest at least once per session instead of trusting it.

where: mergeStates xp/read and pickRec (kinds, speed, cases)
what: Counters merge by max / larger-n-wins, so offline work on one phone is lost whenever both phones studied: xp 100 -> A +50, B +30 merges to 150 not 180; speed pflash A n 20 best 100, B n 15 lvl 4 merges to n 20 lvl 2 (B's 5 drills and level lost); case ch-dka keeps B's record and drops A's best=1.
evidence: S1 in t25/sabotage.py: results xp 150; speed {'n':20,'c':18,'best':100,'lvl':2}; cases {'res':'2 wrong turns','n':3} without best.
fix: Make counters per-device: store S.ctr[deviceId]={xp,read,roundsDone} and sum across devices (a G-counter); for records merge field-wise: n,c as per-device sums or at least max per field, best=max, lvl=max, last=max, res from the record with the larger last.

where: Token expiry by time (signedIn, click renewal)
what: If Buffer stays open past the token lifetime (about 1 h), signedIn() turns false but G.expired stays false, so: the save hook stops syncing silently, the any-tap renewal never fires, and the Citrus line says 'Google sign-in expired · tap to reconnect' although tapping does nothing (only the Reconnect button works).
evidence: S6b: G.exp=Date.now()-1000; save(); tap a tab -> [signedIn false, __tok unchanged, G.expired false]; Citrus line reads 'Google sign-in expired · tap to reconnect. Progress saved to Drive'. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-citrus-line-expired.png
fix: Derive expiry from time: in the click handler and in save() use const dead=wasConnected()&&!signedIn(); set G.expired=true when G.tok&&G.exp<=Date.now(). Also clear G.line when the state changes so the old 'Progress saved to Drive' does not sit next to 'expired'.

what: Drive merge checks `a.round.date===today()`, but a Round is saved with `day`, not `date` (ui5.js line 28). Every Drive merge therefore sets o.round=null. If the app reloads after a sync, an in-progress Round is lost.
evidence: ui5.js: ROUND={legs,i,t0,xp0,day:today()}; hub.js line 104 uses .date. boot() restores only S.round.day===today().
fix: Use `.day` in mergeStates (prefer the round with higher i).

what: The plan test is always true when a plan object exists, because of precedence: `(G.plan&&G.plan.status!=='none'||G.plan)`. A block with status 'none' shows 'Citrus suggests today · 25 min', with 25 made up as a default.
evidence: G.plan={status:'none'} → 'Citrus suggests today · 25 min.'
fix: Use `G.plan&&G.plan.status!=='none'`. Do not default minutes to 25: omit the minutes when they are absent.

what: On the day after a night shift the plan card says 'after a night' and caps at 10 min, but the Citrus line says nothing about why ('No block from Citrus yet today.'). The shift sentence only appears when today itself has a shift.
evidence: G.planDays[yesterday]={shift:{code:'N'}} → Citrus line 'No block from Citrus yet today.'
fix: Add 'After last night's shift · kept light (10 min).' when slot==='postnight', and 'Night tonight · short Round' for 'before'.

what: When Buffer is opened from a file (file://, e.g. a downloaded copy, or the beta copy), Settings says 'You are viewing the claude.ai copy', which is wrong for that context. renderCitrusLine has the same issue.
evidence: Open the frozen copy by file://: Settings → Google & Citrus shows 'You are viewing the claude.ai copy. Google cannot sign in here…'.
fix: Pick the wording from location: claude.ai/claudeusercontent → 'the claude.ai copy'; file: → 'a copy opened from a file'; otherwise 'this copy'. Then add 'Open the installed app (GitHub Pages) to sync.'

what: asks[] emits slots 'early' and 'postnight' as well as 'free'/'before'; the Citrus contract lists slot free/before. (Doubt: Citrus may accept more values; check hub-contract.md.)
evidence: Baseline twophones.py: tomorrow after a night shift -> ask {slot:'postnight',minutes:10}; slotFor() returns 'early' when a shift starts before 07:00.
fix: Either map early/postnight to 'free' with a separate field (kind:'postnight') or update hub-contract.md and Citrus to accept them.

what: Drive errors are shown as raw JSON ('Drive 429: {"error": {"code": 429, "message": ...') in Settings and the Citrus line, while the status box stays green 'Connected'. The Retry-After header is ignored (back-off 0.8/1.6/3.2 s, so a 30-60 s quota window still fails; the sync took 17 s and failed).
evidence: S7 persistent 429; screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-google-card-429.png. Also the error text is carried into the later 'Sign-in expired' line (/tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-google-adv-deck.png).
fix: Parse the error JSON: map 429/403 rateLimit to 'Google Drive is busy; will retry in a minute', 403 storageQuotaExceeded to 'Your Drive is full', 404 to 'File missing'. Honour Retry-After (cap 60 s) and schedule one later retry. Show an amber state in .g-status when the last sync failed, and clear G.line on sign-in changes.

what: There is no 'online' listener: after offline edits nothing syncs until the next save or a 10-minute visibility return; the box still says 'Connected' with 'No connection'.
evidence: S1: sync while offline -> G.line 'No connection' after ~5 s of retries; no automatic retry on reconnect.
fix: addEventListener('online',()=>signedIn()&&syncAll(false)); show 'Offline · will sync when back' in the status box.

what: Each sync makes 13 Drive calls when nothing changed and 19 when forced, and every app backgrounding forces a full upload plus a verify read even when the hash matches. This raises the rate-limit risk and the chance of a sync being cut off at pagehide.
evidence: S2: CALLS per sync (no change, forced) = (13, 19); state.json 2 KB. Code: if(mh!==rh||opts.force) always PUTs.
fix: Skip the upload when mh===rh even when forced (force should mean 'check now', not 'rewrite'). Verify cached folder ids once per session, not on every call. Use fetch keepalive for the pagehide sync.

what: Duplicate state.json files are trashed before their contents are read or merged, so the older copy's data only survives if the phone that wrote it syncs again.
evidence: Code: getJSON() calls trashExtras(files) before reading; S4 shows the good older copy is used only when the newest is damaged.
fix: Read every duplicate, mergeStates them into one, write it, then trash the extras.

what: If the Google script has not loaded yet (slow network, first 800 ms), connectGoogle awaits the script load and then calls requestAccessToken outside the tap, which phone browsers block as a pop-up. (Doubt: depends on browser activation rules; not reproducible headless.)
evidence: Code: hub.js:15 await gsi() before initTokenClient; preload at 800 ms only.
fix: Disable the Connect/Reconnect buttons until window.google.accounts exists ('Loading Google…'), and call requestAccessToken synchronously in the click handler.

what: adopt() keeps the pre-merge state in localStorage buffer_before_drive, but no screen offers to restore it.
evidence: S3: localStorage.getItem('buffer_before_drive') present after the reset was adopted; Settings has no option to use it.
fix: Add 'Undo the last Drive merge (dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm)' under Settings > Your data while that key exists.

what: Merge messages name navigator.platform: 'Merged with Linux x86_64' (on Android it says 'Linux armv8l', on an iPhone 'iPhone').
evidence: S4: G.line 'Merged with Linux x86_64'.
fix: Let the user name the device once (Settings, default 'Phone'/'Tablet'/'Steam Deck' from the user agent) and save it as S.google.deviceName; show 'Merged with Tablet at 14:02'.

what: When connected, the primary orange button is 'Reconnect' and 'Sync now' is secondary; there is no 'last synced' time.
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-google-card-429.png.
fix: Connected: primary 'Sync now', secondary 'Sign out', link 'Reconnect' under Advanced; add 'Last synced 13/11/2026 14:02' from a saved timestamp.

what: Use per-device counters and field-wise record merges (see the counter finding); this removes most 'max wins' losses and makes the merge provably additive.
evidence: S1 results.
fix: Add S.dev (random id); S.ctr[dev]; derived totals.

what: Publish sync health in status.json (lastSyncOk, lastSyncAt, error) so Citrus can say 'Buffer has not synced for 3 days'.
evidence: Today a broken sync leaves status.json stale without any hint.
fix: Add s.sync={ok,at,error} in hubStatus.

what: Commit the fake-Drive sabotage harness (t25/sabotage.py, race.py, dl.py) to /home/claude/buffer/tests so every release reruns two-phone, reset, restore, corruption, 429 and expiry scenarios.
evidence: Harness at /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/t25/.
fix: Copy into tests/ and point it at buffer.html.

what: Consider the drive.file scope: all family apps share one client ID, so files they create stay visible to each other, and the consent screen is far less alarming than full Drive access. (Doubt: files or folders the user made by hand would be invisible.)
evidence: scope 'openid email https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive'.
fix: Test drive.file across Citrus, Yuzu and Buffer before switching.

what: Renewing on any tap opens Google's window in the middle of a quiz answer or a case step. Prefer a slim top banner 'Drive paused · Reconnect' with one button.
evidence: document click handler hub.js:142.
fix: Replace the global handler with a banner button.
